🚀 How to Deploy $GANG
1
Open Remix IDE
Go to remix.ethereum.org in your browser
2
Paste GANGToken.sol
Create a new file and paste in the full contract source code
3
Compile with Solidity 0.8.20+
Select compiler version 0.8.20 or higher and hit compile
4
Deploy to Cronos Mainnet
Select "Injected Provider — MetaMask", set network to Cronos (Chain ID 25), pass your wallet address as the constructor argument, then Deploy
5
Paste your contract address here
Copy the deployed address from MetaMask / CronoScan and replace 0x4cE15b52a34dE6F62448fDBAdDF1dB4811DDC3EF in the CONTRACTS object in this app's source code

FAQ
Common Questions Answered
IS THIS SAFE? CAN YOU RUG?
All contracts are deployed on Cronos and can be verified on CronoScan. The MasterChef contract controls farm emissions — ownership actions are transparent and trackable on-chain. 300 million $GANG is locked in the MasterChef for farm rewards. No hidden mint functions. Check our Contracts page to verify everything yourself.
HOW DO THE FARMS WORK?
Stake your LP tokens (e.g., CRO/GANG) in the MasterChef contract to earn $GANG rewards. The emission rate determines how much $GANG is distributed per second across all farms. Each farm has an allocation that determines its share of the total emissions. APRs are calculated live from on-chain data.
WHAT ARE THE VAULTS?
Auto-compound vaults automatically harvest your farm rewards and reinvest them into more LP tokens. This compounds your returns without you having to manually harvest and restake. Higher APY than manual farming.
HOW DOES THE LOTTERY WORK?
Buy tickets with CRO. Each ticket = 1 chance to win. When the round ends, a winner is drawn. 70% of the pot goes to the winner, 20% is burned forever (reducing $GANG supply), and 10% goes to the treasury. Weekly draws.
HOW DO REFERRALS WORK?
Share your referral link. When someone stakes through your link, you earn 5% of their farming rewards automatically via the on-chain referral contract. No limits on referrals. Rewards are claimable anytime.
WHERE ARE THE FEES?
Swaps: 0.3% (standard DEX fee, goes to LP providers). NFT Marketplace: 2.5% per sale. Token Creator: tier-based CRO fee. LP Locker: 1 CRO per lock. Launchpad: 3% of IDO sale. All fees are transparent and verifiable on-chain.
WHAT WALLET DO I NEED?
Any wallet that supports Cronos chain — MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Crypto.com DeFi Wallet, Rabby, or OKX Wallet. Make sure you're connected to Cronos network (Chain ID 25). The app will auto-prompt you to switch if needed.

HOW TO TRADE LEVERAGE
1. SELECT YOUR PAIR
Choose from Crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL...), Stocks (AAPL, TSLA, NVDA...), or Commodities (Gold, Silver, Oil). Each pair shows a live TradingView chart and real-time price.
2. CHOOSE LONG OR SHORT
LONG = You profit when the price goes UP. SHORT = You profit when the price goes DOWN. Pick based on your market prediction.
3. SET YOUR LEVERAGE
Choose from 5x to 20x leverage. Higher leverage = bigger profits but also bigger risk. At 10x, a 1% price move gives you a 10% gain (or loss). Be careful with high leverage!
4. ENTER YOUR AMOUNT
Enter how many GANG tokens to use as margin. Your position size will be Amount x Leverage. You can set optional Take Profit and Stop Loss prices to auto-close.
5. OPEN & MANAGE POSITION
Hit the Open button to enter your trade. Your position appears below with live P&L tracking. Close anytime to take profit or cut losses. Payouts are in $GANG tokens from the liquidity pool.

HOW FLASH LOANS WORK
1
Borrow any amount
Borrow up to the entire liquidity pool with zero collateral. No credit check, no limit.

Execute your strategy
